data.one_liner: Widget that reports its size changes via a callback.
data.what_it_does: Provides a MeasureSize widget that calls a callback with the rendered size of its child. MeasureSizeBuilder can measure multiple prototypes in a single layout pass.
use_when: You need to react to a widget's size after it is rendered
Building adaptive layouts that depend on actual widget dimensions
avoid_when: You require size information before the first layout pass
You need to measure PreferredSizeWidget reliably
strengths: Simple API with just a child and onChange callback
MeasureSizeBuilder can handle multiple widgets efficiently
weaknesses: Does not work with PreferredSizeWidget on the first frame
Only provides size after layout, not during build
